_comment: Confluent Cloud fully-managed PostgreSQL CDC Source V2 (Debezium).
Streams the WMS operational tables out of Postgres into Kafka with zero
application change - the Laravel WMS keeps writing to Postgres exactly as
before, and every INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE lands in Kafka.
The ExtractNewRecordState transform unwraps the Debezium envelope so the
topic value matches the flat Avro schemas in schemas/ (and so Flink can read
the topics directly as changelog tables).
Replace every <...> placeholder. Do NOT commit real secrets - keep this file
as the template and inject credentials from your shell or a secret manager.
name: wms-postgres-cdc-source
_sslmode_note: Use 'prefer' when pointing at the ngrok-tunnelled demo Postgres (no TLS cert). Use 'require' against a real managed Postgres.
slot.name: wms_cdc_slot
publication.name: wms_cdc_publication
plugin.name: pgoutput
